Task:
Bug report: users are logged out after about 30 seconds of inactivity although the session timeout is 30 minutes. a session seen 60 seconds ago is still valid a session seen 31 minutes ago has expired all checks pass

Candidate files:
- auth/sessions.py: auth/sessions.py Login sessions: a session expires after its timeout (minutes) without activity. SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES = … def is_expired(last_seen: float, now: float, timeout_minutes: int=SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES) -> bool
- web/login.py: web/login.py Login page handlers: start a session, log out when it expired. def still_logged_in(last_seen: float, now: float) -> bool auth.sessions
- scheduler/timeouts.py: scheduler/timeouts.py Job timeouts: a job that runs longer than its timeout (minutes) is killed. def job_timed_out(started: float, now: float, timeout_minutes: int) -> bool
- auth/tokens.py: auth/tokens.py API tokens: expire after a fixed number of seconds. TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = … def token_expired(issued_at: float, now: float, ttl_seconds: int=TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS) -> bool
- cache/ttl_cache.py: cache/ttl_cache.py A cache whose entries expire after a timeout in seconds. class TTLCache   def __init__(self, timeout_seconds: float=60) -> None   def get(self, key: str) -> object | None   def put(self, key: str, value: object) -> None time
- auth/old_sessions.py: auth/old_sessions.py DEPRECATED session store (cookie based); kept until the migration ends. Not used for timeouts. def session_cookie_name() -> str
